answer: Operator-Linked Admission Caps. Each operator gets a fixed onboarding capacity per period; every admitted identity consumes one slot. A regulated shale of operator accounts is published, so clusters are visible before abuse. On confirmed sybil evidence, the operator's capacity is cut and future admissions throttled, creating a ripple across all their wallets at once. The cost is losing scarce admission rights permanently, not just one pearl of stake.
